how_adapted: Notes: the reuse-first search (browser GitHub search) found no usable implementation of the wiki server, page store, versioning/history, LCS line diff, search, or editor UI, so these were written from scratch. Found but not used: a diff viewer (sidcore-dev/diffview, 0 stars, a textarea-based UI) and no wiki project matched the spec. The markdown glue (GFM tables and strikethrough as AST/pre-pass transforms, wiki-link pass, GitHub slugs, safety rules) is also project code on top of the vendored commonmark.js.
